theme.primary_mode: Light Editorial with Dark Ink Accents

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

key_components.name: Navigation Header
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with semi-opaque dark ink backdrop (`bg-[#14202E]/95 backdrop-blur-md`), brand logo, category tabs, currency switcher, and cart drawer button with item counter badge.

key_components.name: Hero Banner
key_components.description: Editorial split hero with rich narrative statement ('Jewelry, Reimagined'), gold accents, and direct CTA to explore collections or launch story.

key_components.name: Heritage Craft Explorer
key_components.description: Interactive showcase highlighting traditional Indian craft techniques: Thewa (Pratapgarh), Hupari Silver (Kolhapur), Gulabi Meenakari (Varanasi), Karimnagar Silver Filigree, and Odisha Silver Filigree.

key_components.name: Product Catalog & Filtering
key_components.description: Searchable, multi-filterable grid supporting craft type, material (925 Silver, Champagne Gold, Pearls), category (Pendants, Necklaces, Rings, Bracelets), price range, and sorting options.

key_components.name: Product Card
key_components.description: Luxury product card with dual image hover effect, material tags, price in INR/USD, quick add to bag button, and wishlist toggle.

key_components.name: Product Details Modal / View
key_components.description: Detailed modal displaying multi-angle image gallery, material authentication specs (925 Silver hallmark, hand-enameling note), sizing guide, and customer reviews.

key_components.name: Cart Drawer & Review
key_components.description: Slide-over drawer with item list, quantity adjusters, gift wrapping / custom message input, coupon code validation, subtotal calculation, and instant checkout preview modal.

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: Transition duration 300ms ease, subtle scale on card image (`group-hover:scale-105`), subtle border highlight on cards.
motion_and_interactions.modal_animation: Fade in with backdrop blur and smooth scale up from 95% to 100%.
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Trigger Sonner toast on 'Add to Bag' and 'Save to Wishlist' actions with custom dark ink style.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve and build upon the Navidha brand identity using warm ivory (#FBF9F5), deep navy ink (#14202E), and champagne gold (#C8A45D).
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or popovers; always use semi-opaque background with backdrop blur.
Implement comprehensive data-testid attributes on all interactive elements: inputs, buttons, filter toggles, product cards, cart items, and modals.
Provide complete local state management for filtering, search, quick view modal, cart drawer (item quantity, removal, promo code), and mock checkout workflow.
Ensure high contrast and accessibility compliance across all light and dark text combinations.
